basis.factory_field: _factory_seal is process-local object identity and is excluded from as_dict()/sha256()
basis.deep_validator: validate_reentry_uptake_binding rebuilds from exact witness, uptake receipt, plan, selection, broadcast and cell_input

risk: A G3 repair that treats _factory_seal presence as exact GWT lineage authority creates process-local authority. A legitimate factory-produced binding serialized through its public canonical payload and rehydrated in another process/restart cannot reproduce the private object-identity seal, while a seal-preserving in-process dataclasses.replace mutation is separately covered by VSR08C.
setup: Create one valid binding with bind_reentry_to_uptake() from exact admitted WP507/WP508 source objects.
Serialize only the binding's canonical public payload via as_dict() or an equivalent durable record that intentionally excludes process-local object identity.
Cross a process/restart boundary and reconstruct the public binding fields without inventing a private seal.
Exercise the proposed WP717 exact-GWT consumer path with the original exact source-lineage objects available for revalidation.
required_result: Exact GWT semantics must be recoverable by revalidating the existing WP507/WP508 source-lineage authority after rehydration; the consumer must not require an unreconstructible process-local seal as the sole authority and must not promote a rehydrated binding without deep source-lineage validation.
why_high_information: Together with VSR08C this closes both sides of a superficial seal-based repair: VSR08C catches false acceptance after seal-preserving mutation; VSR08D catches false dependence on an ephemeral seal across persistence/restart. The existing deep validator already provides the reusable non-duplicate authority path.
repair_guidance: Keep _factory_seal as an optional in-process fast-path marker only. For exact GWT lineage after any serialization/restart boundary, carry or resolve the exact existing witness/uptake/plan/selection/broadcast/cell_input identities and call validate_reentry_uptake_binding, or use an already-admitted immutable proof that is cryptographically bound to those exact identities and the binding digest. Do not create a second GWT authority.
next_exact_action: G3 mutation owner incorporates VSR08D when choosing the smallest GWT lineage repair. Repository CI must pass VSR07/VSR08/VSR08C/VSR08D before any new exact-source VPS promotion subject is bound; real GWT runtime credit still requires measured uptake/re-entry rather than fixture construction.
